narrative.overview: All admin routes use one Shopify-inspired token source at app/admin/design-tokens.css. This file is descriptive metadata, not a stylesheet or token generator. The maintained developer contract is developer-docs/admin-design-system.md; DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md own direction and behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navigation, white working surfaces, neutral pill actions and blue keyboard focus.
Shared component recipes with module-owned task layouts.
Public tenant branding and the real Content website iframe remain independent.
rules: Use semantic aliases backed by --sd-* definitions; do not inherit admin appearance from tenant presets.
Scope global admin selectors to .showrunner-admin; keep the document reset theme-free.
Use the canonical guide for scales, examples and verification; update this metadata when the source contract changes.
dos: Reuse shared controls and preserve labels, validation and focus behavior.
Use media tokens for photographic canvases and keep data-driven geometry local.
Check desktop/mobile and public isolation after shared recipe changes.
donts: Do not add a competing per-module palette or control skin.
Do not force reserved blank slots into ordinary cards.
Do not recolor the website iframe or reconstruct it as synthetic editor cards.
